summary_1line: Krishna and Arjuna slaughter forest creatures and defeat attacking gods and spirits during the burning of Khandava forest.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna shatters a hurled mountain peak from Indra into a thousand flaming fragments with a storm of arrows.
Krishna hurls his blazing discus into the burning forest, cutting through demons and serpents as flames roar around him.
The sky fills with gods on celestial mounts raising thunderbolt, mace, lance, and noose against the calm figures of Krishna and Arjuna.
